verdict.rationale: Whether a public digital service publishes its platform source under an open license is a fair question, so this axis applies to INPI. Nothing in the pack shows INPI publishing its own source code under an open license. The docs about software patents (docs-5) and e-Soleau/escrow deposits (docs-6) cover users protecting their own code, not INPI's code. The data.inpi.fr probe concerns token-gated access to IP data, not source availability.
